summary: 23 of 25 filed reviews hold up: their quoted and paraphrased claims about the sampled items check out verbatim against the packet, and verdicts follow logically from their own rationales, with no detected template transplantable across sibling nodes. Two nodes are voided for misrepresenting their own sample set rather than for any judgment failure: mat_g1_na_q2_3's coverage rationale fabricates a tens-digit sequence that drops the one sample (seed 500, value 50) that would have contradicted its claim, and mat_g1_na_q3_5's variant-comprehensiveness rationale asserts that read_mcq items carry the expanded-form 'X tens Y ones' narration when the two actual read_mcq samples (seeds 55, 500) are bare 'How many items are left?' stems with no such framing -- discovered independently during re-judgment before the filed review was consulted, and it flipped my verdict on that node from the filed PASS to CONCERN. Independent re-judgment of 5 nodes (mat_g1_na_q2_2, mat_g1_na_q3_0, mat_g1_na_q3_5, mat_g1_na_q4_2, mat_g2_dp_q3_0) produced 1 disagreement (mat_g1_na_q3_5), a 20% rate that sits exactly at, not over, the stated reliability threshold, and 2 voided nodes is 'a couple,' not 'more than a couple.' Both metrics land right on the boundary, so the batch is marked reliable, but the fact that the one independently-discovered defect and the one systematically-discovered defect are the same species of error (a coverage/format claim quietly misdescribing which samples actually carry a required feature) means the other 23 PASS/CONCERN/FAIL calls deserve a second look on this specific failure mode before being treated as fully trustworthy.
